proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item UnitRecord kind
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord is currently SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord. There is no magic_item variant. The v4 taxonomy lists magic_item_root as a source atom but the surface type system has no corresponding record kind or mechanics family.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Censer of Controlling Air Elementals is a Wondrous Item — it cannot be represented as a spell, class feature, or mastery without lying about what it is.

proposed_widenings.name: summoning mechanics family (create_companion)
proposed_widenings.justification: The core effect is summoning a specific named creature type (Air Elemental) that obeys commands, acts on its own initiative, and persists until dismissed/dead/time-expired. The v4 taxonomy has a create_companion effect atom, but no surface mechanics family emits it. A summoning family is needed for magic items (and spells like Conjure Elemental).
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Magic action to summon an Air Elemental. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the censer as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count.

proposed_widenings.name: dawn reset cadence
proposed_widenings.justification: The censer recharges at next dawn — a wall-clock/day-cycle reset that is not any of the existing RestResetCadence kinds (short_or_long_rest | long_rest | short_rest | partial_short_full_long). Many magic items use this pattern; it needs its own variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The censer can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

proposed_widenings.name: magic_action activation cost
proposed_widenings.justification: The item is activated by taking the Magic action (a standard action kind in SRD 5.2.1). ClassFeatureActivationCost only allows free | bonus_action. A magic_action variant is needed for items and features that spend the Magic action.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Magic action to summon an Air Elemental

proposed_widenings.name: bonus_action dismiss lifecycle
proposed_widenings.justification: The elemental can be dismissed as a Bonus Action by the wielder, as a named dismissal cost mid-duration. The existing expire/dismiss lifecycle atoms don't carry an action-cost on the dismiss itself — this is a wielder-chosen early termination that costs a Bonus Action.
proposed_widenings.evidence: when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action

notes: The primary blocker is structural: UnitRecord has no magic_item kind, so no JSON that typechecks can be authored. Secondary blockers compound: the mechanics require a summoning family (create_companion effect), a dawn reset cadence, and a magic_action activation cost — none of which exist in the current surface. The companion lifecycle (1-hour timed expiry OR death OR bonus-action dismiss) is also a non-trivial multi-condition expiry shape. At minimum, MagicItemRecord + a summoning/conjuration mechanics family must be added before this unit can be encoded honestly.
